title: Japanese Onigiri with Plum Jam
description: A simple and delicious Japanese dish featuring triangular onigiri rice balls filled with sweet plum jam.
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly and cook according to the package instructions.
Once the rice is cooked, let it cool down to room temperature.
Mix the cooled rice with a pinch of salt and water to achieve the right consistency.
Divide the rice mixture into 3-4 equal parts and shape each part into a triangular onigiri.
Cut a small hole in the center of each onigiri and fill it with 1-2 teaspoons of plum jam.
Gently press the edges of the onigiri to seal the filling and shape the rice into a neat triangle.
Serve the onigiri triangles immediately or store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a day.
